about: Progress of an item wall's raising animation, owned by esv::itemwall::WallSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3379B60): created with bg3.exe+0x337AD40 when a CreateComponent is processed, filled by eoc::itemwall::GetItemAnimations(ItemWall, ItemSpawns, out DynamicArray<ItemAnimation>) at +8, then each frame its time grows by the delta time and the animation steps that are due are popped from the back of the array; when the array is empty the component is removed. Saved: model game.itemwall.v0.AnimationComponent (40 bytes, no member names known). Never seen alive. Registry total 72 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x337AD40 (AllocRaw 0x48) writes dword 0. WallSystem line 787 adds the frame's delta time to the float at +0 (stride 0x48), and line 571 compares it with each animation step's time.

Creator zeroes qwords +8/+0x10 and dword +0x14 (Array shape). WallSystem line 356 passes +8 of the component to GetItemAnimations as its output DynamicArray<eoc::itemwall::ItemAnimation>; line 769: component removed when the 32-bit count at +0x14 is 0; lines 568-574 pop elements from the back (count at +0x14, data at +8, stride 0x10).

Creator zeroes +0x18..+0x47 in the HashSet pattern (dword +0x34 and +0x44 counts). WallSystem line 685 passes the component's +0x18 and the entity to bg3.exe+0x721030 (8-byte key set insert); a ForcePushRequestOneFrameComponent is created only when the entity was newly inserted - the set of entities already pushed.
